summary: Events, professionals and services are all substantially built on backend and web, and every gap here is about money movement and a few model mismatches, not missing domains. Events ticketing (event + event-ticketing modules; EventOrder/EventTicket/EventTicketType/EventReferral models, there is no separate event-order module) already does verified-only hosting, admin review, tiered capacity-safe sales, QR check-in and cancel-with-refund, but every paid path is Flutterwave: buy() returns flutterwaveConfig, verifyOrder() verifies a Flutterwave charge, cancel() calls flutterwave.refundCharge, EventOrder is keyed on flutterwaveTxRef, and the host's 85% is computed on the dashboard but never paid into any wallet. Moving to the Fintava wallet means a buyer wallet and PIN that do not exist, a provider-neutral EventOrder reference, wallet credits for refunds, host settlement, and above all a ruling on who holds ticket money between sale and event (the CBN custody line in the product rules). Professionals match the bundle rule: P1-P10 show paid DMs only, with no booking, calendar or escrow, and the backend says the same. Two open points: the 24-hour auto-refund is a conditional hold that may count as escrow once it is paid from a wallet, and the board's field names do not match the backend category slugs. Services on the board are bills, bill reminders and legal. Bills exist on Flutterwave Bills with checkout, minus wallet debit, the electricity token and auto-reversal. Bill reminders and push notifications have no backend at all. Legal exists end to end, but its assistant chat only opens after payment while the board puts it first and free, and the board's consultation media and fees and its CAC price (₦35,000 vs ₦25,000) differ from code; the designer flags those fees as placeholders. Health plans, NEPC, partner services, mentors, the /services hub and professional reviews are on the web and backend but absent from these boards. The biggest risk is custody: wallet-paid tickets, refunds and DM refund holds put money in WAWU's hands unless the Fintava structure is ruled on first.
